**Somalia: how applications changed.** The extract records 1,161,820 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 159,194 in 2023, compared with 57,527 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 39% higher than in 2019 (41,378). Applications in 2025 were 45% lower than in 2024 (103,942). In 2025, the leading destinations were Kenya (17,634; 31%), Germany (7,796; 14%), Egypt (5,492; 9.5%). Kenya received 31% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 5.7% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 69%, across 33,002 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 44% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 12.8 percentage points lower than in 2024 (82%).
